definitions.explanation: A disruption to train timetables causing delays or cancellations. ダイヤ is short for ダイヤグラム (diagram), referring to the graphical train schedule used in railway operations.

examples.japanese: ⟦{台風|たいふう}→台風：01455_taifuu⟧⟦による→による：28349_niyoru⟧ダイヤ{乱|みだ}れで、⟦{電車|でんしゃ}→電車：00522_densha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧2⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦{遅延|ちえん}→遅延：06749_chien⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Due to typhoon-related schedule disruption, the train was delayed by two hours.

examples.japanese: ⟦{人身事故|じんしんじこ}→人身事故：08475_jinshinjiko⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{影響|えいきょう}→影響：01877_eikyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧ダイヤ{乱|みだ}れ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発生|はっせい}しています→発生する：25529_hasseisuru⟧。
examples.english: Schedule disruptions have occurred due to a passenger accident.

examples.japanese: ⟦{朝|あさ}→朝：02277_asa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ラッシュ→ラッシュ：11221_rasshu⟧⟦{時|じ}→時：09869_ji⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ダイヤ{乱|みだ}れ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発生|はっせい}する→発生する：25529_hasseisuru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{乗|の}り{換|か}え→乗り換える：01194_norikaeru⟧⟦{駅|えき}→駅：02180_eki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{大混雑|おおこんざつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{起|お}きる→起きる：00521_okiru⟧。
examples.english: When schedule disruption occurs during the morning rush, transfer stations become extremely crowded.

notes:
USAGE:
⟦ダイヤ→ダイヤ：00032_daiya⟧ (short for ⟦ダイヤグラム→ダイヤグラム：24004_daiyaguramu⟧) in this context means 'train timetable,' not 'diamond.' This usage is specific to railway operations. You will often hear station announcements saying ⟦ダイヤ→ダイヤ：00032_daiya⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{乱|みだ}れて→乱れる：09506_midareru⟧⟦おります→おる：01324_oru⟧ (the schedule is disrupted).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦ダイヤ→ダイヤ：00032_daiya⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{乱|みだ}れる→乱れる：09506_midareru⟧ (the schedule is disrupted)
- ⟦ダイヤ→ダイヤ：00032_daiya⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{乱|みだ}れ→乱れ：11413_midare⟧ (schedule disruption)
- ⟦ダイヤ→ダイヤ：00032_daiya⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{回復|かいふく}する→回復する：21330_kaifukusuru⟧ (the schedule returns to normal)
- ⟦ダイヤ→ダイヤ：00032_daiya⟧{通|どお}り (on schedule)
